actions.purpose: Verify a run: citations, policy results, permits, readbacks, receipts, and versions against the release in force
Protective: open an audit finding with severity, failed control, both exact values, evidence, fix owner, and recommended containment
Protective: put an AI specialist whose own step failed a control on hold until the owner reconfirms its settings
Propose closing a finding after verifying recorded closure evidence from someone other than the actor that caused it; the owner approves
Protective: page or notify a named role about a critical finding, or escalate a request the auditor must decline
Route a canonical object to the specialist that owns the next action, such as a privacy request to compliance
Explain audit records, sampling, and findings to the owner within the owner's read rights
